source:
@@U01850@@
Frankly, I feel nothing! My body’s a wintry thing. I'd rather be trudging through ice and snow. And that humpbacked moon rising reddish and late, how sadly it climbs and gives no light, while we bump trees and crack our shins on rocks. Excuse me while I call on a will-o’-the-wisp. There’s one there, shining ever so brightly! You there! Friend! May I have a word? Why do you keep burning in vain? Be so kind as to light our way up the mountain.

@@U01852@@
Perhaps in respect I can harness my wayward disposition. I usually travel in a reckless zigzag.

@@U01854@@
Listen to him! Doing his best to imitate humans. Just keep going straight, in the Devil’s name, or I'll blow out your flickering life!

@@U01856@@
Since you're the boss here, sir, I'll do my best. Just remember, tonight the mountain’s mad with magic, and if a will-o’-the-wisp’s to guide your way, you'd better not be too particular.

@@U01858@@
(Sings.)

@@U01859@@
Now we're in the sphere, it seems, Of enchantment and of dreams. Lead us on, fair meteor gleam,
translation:
@@U01850@@
说实话，我没什么感觉！我的身体是一个寒冷的东西。我宁愿在冰雪中跋涉。那座驼背月亮升起时微红，很晚，多么可悲的是，它爬升时却没有发光，而我们却撞到了树木，在岩石上摔碎了小腿。对不起，我要召唤鬼火。那里有一个，闪闪发光！你在那里！朋友！我可以说句话吗？为什么你总是徒劳地燃烧？请善意地照亮我们上山的路。

@@U01852@@
也许在尊重中我可以控制我任性的性格。我通常会鲁莽地曲折旅行。

@@U01854@@
听他的！尽最大努力模仿人类。继续直走吧，以魔鬼的名义，否则我会吹灭你闪烁的生命！

@@U01856@@
先生，既然你是这里的老板，我就会尽力而为。请记住，今晚这座山充满了魔法，如果有鬼火指引你的道路，你最好不要太挑剔。

@@U01858@@
（唱歌。）

@@U01859@@
现在我们似乎正处在一个充满魅力和梦想的领域。引导我们前行，美丽的流星光芒，
